goal.semantic: exact standard 7x6 Connect Four solve from the empty board
goal.priority: minimum total machine cost; every repeated primitive E0/E1 operation remains eligible for cycle reduction

runtime.policy: Runtime version is an optimization dimension. Do not transplant AMD Zen 3 cycle constants to this Intel target. Requalify generated code and total cycles on the actual i5.

measurement.wallClock: all workers ready and TT pages initialized -> empty root constructed -> exact result observed; initialization and cleanup separate

qualification.governingUnit: complete exact empty-board solve from initialized ready application; position-specific construction included
qualification.cycleAuthority: actual i5 process-cycle measurement plus current generated/runtime evidence where primitive lowering is load-bearing
qualification.targetPass: EXACT result and wallMs <= 10000 on the declared local target
benchmarkHierarchy: trace-derived early/mid empty-board subtrees weighted by measured full-solve work
nonRepresentativeForPromotion: settled/near-terminal positions dominated by startup or teardown
legacy CPC/NDC instant-closure cases when evaluating minimal-worker search throughput
fixture averages that do not weight work by empty-board search contribution
qualification.proxyAdmission: A proxy performance suite must be derived from an actual empty-board solve trace or partial trace and must represent the early/mid subtrees that dominate measured nodes/cycles/time.
qualification.priorFixturePerformanceClaims: provisional for empty-board objective until confirmed by target full-solve or trace-derived representative bulk-search evidence

developmentEmptyBoardEvidence.environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04, Node 26.10.0; not target hardware
developmentEmptyBoardEvidence.interpretation: Representative development full solve did not complete. Late/endgame fixture timing is regression evidence only; performance promotion requires target full solve or admitted trace-derived bulk-search proxies.

retainedLocalhostAuthority.note: Descriptive profile only; recover actual invocation/raw evidence before benchmarking.
